WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    COUNT(*) as status_count,
    AVG(gbsize / spanmin) as status_avg_rate
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites z ON s.zoneref = z.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(gbsize / spanmin) as overall_rate
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites z ON s.zoneref = z.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0
)
SELECT 
  AVG(sr.status_avg_rate) as avg_rate,
  AVG(sr.status_count) as avg_count,
  AVG(sr.status_avg_rate) - (SELECT overall_rate FROM overall_avg) as avg_excess
FROM status_rates sr
WHERE sr.status_avg_rate > (SELECT overall_rate FROM overall_avg)
